title: min/max/sum with std::minmax_element
prompt: Implement `Stats stats(const std::vector<int>& v)` where `Stats` has `int min; int max; long sum;`. Return `{0, 0, 0}` for an empty vector. Use `std::minmax_element` for the extremes and accumulate the sum yourself (or with `std::accumulate`).

tests.name: basic
tests.hint: minmax_element returns a pair of iterators into the vector.

tests.name: single
tests.hint: One element is both min and max.

tests.name: empty
tests.hint: The empty case must be handled before dereferencing.

tests.name: negatives
tests.hint: Negatives must not break the extremes.
